description: Skarbnik, the old spirit of the mines from Silesian legend, looking like a grey-bearded old miner in a black miner's uniform with brass buttons and a black miner's cap with a feather plume, holding up a small glowing oil lamp, a pile of silver ore nuggets at his feet, kindly but mysterious eyes with a faint glow, full body, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, muted dark colours
